data.short_meaning: To be revered, respected, or venerated
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin verb ‘venerare’, meaning ‘to venerate, to revere, or to respect’. This name was given to those who were held in high esteem and honored for their virtuous actions or deep spirituality. The name Veneranda carries the meaning “To be revered, respected, or venerated” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Veneranda usually hope their child will grow to embody to be revered, respected, or venerated and live with faith, good character and purpose.
